# ResKonnect

Canonical site: https://www.reskonnect.org
Brand aliases: ResKonnect, Res Konnect, ResConnect, Res Connect
Country: South Africa
Primary operating focus: student living, education applications, student opportunities, AI-enabled guidance, and student-housing property intelligence.

## What ResKonnect covers

- Student accommodation and private rentals
- Accommodation near universities and TVET campuses
- Application readiness, APS guidance, Course Match and official application direction
- Work Integrated Learning (WIL), internships, SETA programmes and graduate opportunities
- Student-housing properties for sale, third-party auctions, development and conversion opportunities
- ResKonnect AI for student, course, opportunity and property intelligence
- Landlord, institution and business partnerships

## Source and freshness conventions

Public property and opportunity pages distinguish third-party source facts from ResKonnect analysis. Where available, pages expose source links, closing or auction dates, publication dates and last-verification dates. Claims such as accreditation should be independently verified unless a page expressly marks them as verified by ResKonnect.

## Access

Private student dashboards, admin interfaces, documents, messages and account routes are not public search resources. Use the public URLs above for retrieval and citation.
